question: Who are the worshippers addressed in relation to the great goddess?
premises: A group of worshippers is specified by the number twenty-five.
The great goddess is directly addressed.
inference: The teaching is directed toward the twenty-fivefold group of worshippers under the authority of the great goddess.
uncertainties: The specific identity of the twenty-five worshippers is not named in this verse.
plain_english: O great goddess, this concerns the worshippers who are twenty-five in number.
